description: Get Terminal Aerodrome Forecasts (TAFs) for 1–4 named stations, an area bounding box, or a US state or DC. Returns forecast periods, winds, wind shear, visibility, weather, cloud layers, vertical visibility, and raw TAFs. Check each forecast’s validity window for the time of interest. Use aviation_find_stations to check station forecast capability.

as_of.description: Historical issuance reference as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ within the previous 30 days. Check the returned validity window separately. Omit for current forecasts.

bbox.description: Geographic bounding box for a forecast survey.

maxLat.description: Northern boundary latitude in decimal degrees.

maxLon.description: Eastern boundary longitude in decimal degrees.

minLat.description: Southern boundary latitude in decimal degrees.

minLon.description: Western boundary longitude in decimal degrees.

limit.description: Maximum forecasts to return from offset in a bbox or state survey. The served maximum is 400 when limit is supplied. Omit to return all remaining matches.

offset.description: Zero-based survey start ordered by station ID, issue time descending, then raw bulletin.

state.description: Two-letter US state or DC code, case-insensitive. Returns forecasts available through the AWC state selector.

station_ids.description: ICAO station IDs to query. 1–4 stations per call.

items.description: ICAO station ID: 4 ASCII letters or digits, case-insensitive and normalized to uppercase (e.g., KSEA, KJFK, K36U).

name: aviation_get_taf

cap.description: Upstream forecast row cap, shown when reached.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_location`: No location selector was provided. `conflicting_location`: More than one location selector was provided. `invalid_bbox`: The bounding box has inverted latitude or longitude bounds. `invalid_state`: The state code is outside the 50 US states and DC. `conflicting_offset`: offset was supplied for a named station lookup. `conflicting_limit`: A caller limit was provided for a named lookup. `future_as_of`: The historical reference time is in the future. `outside_retention`: The historical reference time predates the AWC retention window. `no_taf_available`: The selected stations or survey returned no forecasts for the requested time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

forecasts.description: TAF products returned for the selected stations or survey.

items.description: A Terminal Aerodrome Forecast for one station.

amended.description: Whether the recognizable bulletin header carries AMD. Null when the header cannot be classified.

forecast_periods.description: Ordered list of forecast periods from base to end of validity.

altimeter_hpa.description: Forecast altimeter setting in hPa. Null when AWC did not supply it.

change_type.description: Change indicator: FM (from), TEMPO (temporary), BECMG (becoming), PROB (a standalone probability group), or null for the base period. A PROB30 or PROB40 qualifying a temporary group arrives as TEMPO; standing alone, with no temporary group after it, it arrives as PROB. Either way the percentage is in probability.

clouds.description: Forecast cloud layers for this period, as AWC decoded them — at most three, so a further layer is left out of this array and its text surfaces in not_decoded, with raw_taf the complete source. Empty whenever the period published no layer heights, which covers a forecast clear sky and a period carrying no cloud element at all; sky_condition distinguishes them. An empty array is not a forecast of a clear sky on its own.

base_ft.description: Cloud base altitude in feet AGL. On an OVX layer this is the vertical visibility into the obscuration rather than a layer bottom, and 0 is a surface-level indefinite ceiling.

cover.description: Sky cover code: FEW, SCT, BKN, OVC, SKC, or OVX. OVX is the decoded form of a VVhhh group — the sky is obscured and the base is the vertical visibility into it, not a cloud bottom.

type.description: Cloud type qualifier: CB (cumulonimbus), TCU (towering cumulus), or null. An obscuration can carry one — a VV008CB group is an OVX layer with type CB.

from.description: Period start time in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

icing_turbulence.description: Icing and turbulence layers attached by AWC. Empty when AWC supplied none.

items.description: One decoded icing or turbulence layer.

intensity_code.description: Intensity code as decoded by AWC.

kind.description: AWC layer code, typically ICE or TURB.

max_altitude_ft.description: Upper bound in feet as reported by AWC. Null when unspecified.

min_altitude_ft.description: Lower bound in feet as reported by AWC. Null when unspecified.

not_decoded.description: Text AWC attached to this period without decoding it, trimmed — usually a cloud layer past the three-layer decode limit, sometimes another group such as VV///. Null when nothing was left undecoded. Non-null marks a partial decode. Upstream can attach the leftover of one group, such as a TEMPO, to the period after it, so the text is published on the period it arrived on and never reassigned or parsed into clouds; raw_taf is the complete forecast.

probability.description: Probability percentage (30 or 40) for TEMPO/PROB groups. Null if not specified.

sky_condition.description: The sky condition this period forecast when it published no layer heights: SKC or NSC for a clear or insignificant-cloud forecast (a CAVOK group arrives as NSC), OVX for a forecast obscuration carrying no vertical visibility. Null when clouds carries layers — those are the statement — and also when the period carried no cloud element at all. An empty clouds array beside a null here forecasts nothing about cloud; on a TEMPO, PROB, or BECMG group that means the prevailing forecast stands unchanged, never that the sky will be clear.

temperature_forecasts.description: Temperature extrema attached by AWC. Empty when AWC supplied none.

kind.description: AWC extremum code, typically MAX or MIN.

temperature_c.description: Forecast surface temperature in degrees Celsius.

valid_at.description: Time of the extremum in ISO 8601 UTC, which can fall outside this period.

to.description: Period end time in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

transition_end.description: BECMG transition end in ISO 8601 UTC, independently of the period end. Null when AWC did not supply it.

vertical_visibility_ft.description: Vertical visibility into a forecast obscuration, in feet AGL — an indefinite ceiling, and the same height as this period OVX cloud layer. 0 is a surface-level indefinite ceiling; null means the period forecasts no obscuration.

visibility_sm.description: Forecast visibility in statute miles (e.g., "6", "1/2"). Null if not specified.

decoded.description: Plain-English reading of each group, joined with "; " (e.g., "light rain showers; mist"). A group the decoder does not recognize is carried through as its own raw token rather than half-translated, so compare against raw when a reading still looks coded.

raw.description: Weather groups exactly as forecast, space-delimited (e.g., "-SHRA", "-SHRA BR", "VCTS -RA").

weather.description: Forecast weather for this period, or null when the period carried no weather group.

wind.description: Forecast wind conditions at the surface for this period.

direction_deg.description: Forecast wind direction in degrees true. Null when the forecast said VRB (variable), and also when the period carries no wind element at all — speed_kt is null in that second case and a number in the first.

gust_kt.description: Forecast gust speed in knots, or null if none.

speed_kt.description: Forecast wind speed in knots. 0 is a forecast calm (a 00000KT group); null means the period amends only visibility, weather, or cloud and carries no wind element, so the wind is unknown rather than calm.

direction_deg.description: Forecast wind direction at the top of the shear layer, in degrees true — not a direction of shear.

height_ft.description: Top of the shear layer in feet AGL — not the layer base and not its thickness. A WS020 group is 2000 ft.

speed_kt.description: Forecast wind speed at the top of the shear layer, in knots — the wind at that height, not the magnitude of the shear.

wind_shear.description: Forecast non-convective low-level wind shear (a WS group), confined to the surface–2,000 ft AGL band. A null means no non-convective LLWS group was issued for this period, rather than no shear expected: the group is excluded from TEMPO and PROB groups, and shear is always assumed present in convective activity.

issued_at.description: TAF issue time in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

raw_taf.description: Original encoded TAF string (e.g., "TAF KSEA 041730Z 0418/0524 18010KT P6SM SKC ...").

remarks.description: AWC bulletin remarks, trimmed. Null when no remarks were decoded.

station_id.description: ICAO station identifier, 4 uppercase letters or digits (e.g., KSEA, K36U).

valid_from.description: Forecast validity period start in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

valid_to.description: Forecast validity period end in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

limited.description: Whether the caller limit withheld forecasts from this draw. Present when a survey has a limit.

matched.description: Forecasts in the draw before paging. Present when offset was supplied or limit withheld matches.

missing.description: Requested station IDs absent from the result. Absent when none are missing.

items.description: A requested ICAO station ID that produced no forecast.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page of the currently available draw. Present only while matches remain.

notice.description: Guidance about missing named stations, a capped survey, or a survey limited by the caller.

partial.description: True when a requested station produced no forecast. False affirms the result covers every requested station, so full coverage is distinguishable from a short batch rather than being inferred from the count.

requested.description: Station IDs this call asked for, in the order given.

items.description: An ICAO station ID as requested.

returned.description: Distinct station IDs that produced a forecast.

items.description: An ICAO station ID present in the result.

shown.description: Forecasts shown from a survey after any limit.

truncated.description: Whether a survey reached the upstream row cap. A value of false only says the draw fell below the cap.

title: Get Terminal Aerodrome Forecast (TAF)
